calendar_day.description: Moscow calendar day of the WB `date` field (AD-7, mskDay).

orders_count.description: WB Statistics `orders` rows for the day by `date`, excluding `isCancel` (glossary: Заказы).

sales_count.description: `sales` rows with saleID on `S` for the day (glossary: Продажи).

revenue_rub.description: Money as a string with exactly two decimal places (AD-10); sum of finishedPrice over `S` sales.

forpay_rub.description: Money as a string with exactly two decimal places (AD-10).

source_refs.description: Evidence pointers (AD-1): content_sha256 of the raw artifacts the day was folded from; never empty.
